paragraphs: Hizkiya bar Biluto (in the days of Rabbi Abbahu). Arakhin 28b.[^1]

notes.text: The already-read saved Davidson Arakhin28b scalar explicitly has Chizkiyah bar Biloti speaking before Rabbi Abbahu. It supports Rabbi Abbahu and the cited folio here; in his days remains Hyman’s time characterization. Source בילוטו stays distinct from witness בילוטי, and no global identity is admitted.
